events.subject_response: Caruso denied the allegations and said he maintains his innocence completely. He told reporters after posting bond that he did not know why a child would make up an allegation against him.
events.summary: An Orange County circuit judge granted suspended Palm Beach County Clerk Michael Caruso a $160,000 bond in a pending case involving five felony child-sex-abuse-related charges. The judge ordered passport surrender, no contact with the alleged victim or witnesses, and restrictions on entering Orange County; the proceeding did not determine guilt.
